page.layout: One page of manuscript-like handwriting on a leaf, seen as a photograph of a vellum or paper leaf with show-through and stains; no printed text block. Digitiser's credit line at the foot (not transcribed).
page.notes: The scan shows a leaf with faint, brownish handwritten or cursive script in the upper half and centre, and further faint marks in the lower half. This is handwriting, not printed text, and the digitiser's credit line "Early European Books, Copyright © 2012 ProQuest LLC. Images reproduced by courtesy of The Wellcome Trust, London. 4974/A" is excluded. The script is too faint and blurred to read even a single word reliably, so no transcription is given. Stains and show-through make up much of the image.
